description: Cash runway (SEC XBRL) — How many months of cash a US-listed company has left: cash + short-term investments vs trailing-12-month free-cash-flow burn (operating cash flow minus capex) built from 10-K/10-Q XBRL. Verdict SELF-FUNDING / CASH-GENERATIVE / LONG RUNWAY / ADEQUATE / WATCH / TIGHT - LIKELY TO RAISE / CRITICAL, zero-cash date estimate, latest-quarter burn rate, long-term investments, debt due within 12 months and flags. Params: ticker= (or cik=). Source: SEC EDGAR (public domain). Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_cash_runway
